name: Egg Drop Soup
time: Prep 5 min, cook 15 min, total 20 min

items: 1 bunch chopped green onions (or 1 Tbsp dried chopped onion)
2–3 eggs (2 large, 3 if smaller or medium)
1 can whole kernel sweet corn, drained

steps.title: Heat the broth
steps.body: Heat **6 cups chicken broth** and **1 bunch chopped green onions** in a large pot over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Thicken the broth
steps.body: Mix **¼ tsp white sugar**, **2 Tbsp soy sauce**, **3 Tbsp cornstarch** and **⅓ cup cold water** in a bowl until smooth. Reduce heat and stir the soy sauce mixture into the broth. Boil soup on high for 1 minute, then reduce heat to medium-low.

steps.title: Add the eggs
steps.body: Beat **3 eggs** with **2 Tbsp cold water**. Using a fork, stir the egg mixture into the soup and cook until eggs are opaque, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the corn
steps.body: Add **1 can whole kernel sweet corn**, drained. Turn heat to medium low and cook for about 3–5 minutes.
